subject: ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause
notes: kb/Work PB1072 landed (w61c). cite.py --check 12.4.5.6.4 'shall not be provided when the value of data-name-1 or record-key-name-1 in that record is equal to literal-1' -> OK GR6. The suppression value is built at bind time in the key's own positions (DataBinder.KeySuppressionOf): a figurative repeated to the key size in the key's category via FigurativeConstants.FillChar (8.3.3.6.4 GR2), ALL literal-1 repeated, a shorter literal space-extended (8.8.4.2.7 2)), a longer one cut back when its excess is spaces and otherwise never equal; a national key's value is encoded through CobolBits.NatBytes. Golden pb1072_suppress_when_forms: SPACES/SPACE/short/ALL/N/constant-name/symbolic/concatenation/HIGH-VALUES/long-with-spaces suppress, long-non-space does not; READ KEY by the suppression value -> 23; walks omit suppressed records. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Frontend/Common/CobolLiteral.cs#Decode (the SUPPRESS WHEN operand is no longer decoded raw; it is read by DataBinder.ReadSuppressWhen and sized by KeySuppressionOf (kb/Work PB1072)) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/IO/IndexedConnector.cs#IsSuppressed (the INDEXED organization moved to the keyed store engine (kb/Work PB3334; DESIGN-runtime-library 2.2.1.4): a record whose alternate key equals its SUPPRESS WHEN value has no entry in that key's tree (IndexedConnector.AlternateValue))
